name: constrained-map-test-60915d9ec9/constrained-map-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.error lists only message.
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: error:message.
reason: The case depends on error.detail() to extract and assert cast and cloneWithType diagnostic messages. lang.error:detail is absent from both the supported library methods and method-call positive lists, making this whole case a feature request.
unsupported_constructs: error.detail() calls, including e.detail()["message"], e2.detail(), e3.detail(), er.detail(), and jsonError.detail()
test_design_notes: The @output assertions include exact cast diagnostics and sliced conversion diagnostics obtained through unsupported detail() calls; these are essential asserted behavior. io:println is only output instrumentation.
